notes: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for LLM rates. The gateway's Rust table (src/policy/pricing_catalog.rs) and the platform's TypeScript table (packages/telemetry/src/pricing/generated/index.ts) are hand-maintained copies of these rows. Edit this file first, then mirror the same change into both tables by hand.

cachedInputPer1m is the rate for a prompt-cache HIT (input tokens served from cache). null means the provider publishes no cached rate for this model, which the cost engine reports as a MISSING DIMENSION rather than pricing at zero.
cacheWritePer1m is the rate for tokens written to the cache at the provider's DEFAULT TTL. 0.0 means the provider documents no cache-write charge. null means unknown.
cacheWrite1hPer1m is Anthropic's 1-hour-TTL cache write (2x base). null when the provider has a single write rate.
Gemini charges cached content as storage per hour rather than per written token; no response field reports that time, so it is out of scope for per-request costing and cacheWritePer1m is 0.0.
legacy: true marks rows carried over verbatim from the platform's pre-catalog table. Their base rates are unverified and they carry no cache dimensions.
authoritativeCostNote: xAI documents usage.cost_in_usd_ticks as the exact billed per-request total, inclusive of caching discounts and server-side tools (1 USD = 10^10 ticks): https://docs.x.ai/developers/cost-tracking. Perplexity explicitly disclaims its estimate, so it is not listed.
